# Average Grade Calculator

> Average Grade Calculator is a Next.js calculator suite offering free academic, conversion, utility and finance calculators with browser-based inputs, responsive UI, and public legal/support pages.

## Docs

- [Robots](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/robots.txt): Search crawler directives for public indexing.
- [Ads](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/ads.txt): Advertising seller declaration file.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/privacy-policy): Public privacy and data handling documentation.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/terms-of-service): Public usage terms and legal agreement.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/): Main calculator library and product overview.
- [About](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/about): Mission, values, privacy-first approach, and popular tools.
- [Contact](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/contact): Support contact options and message form.
- [FAQ](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/faq): Common questions and answers about using the website.

## Calculators

- [GPA Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/gpa-calculator): Calculate GPA using course grades and credit hours.
- [CGPA Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/cgpa-calculator): Calculate cumulative GPA across multiple semesters.
- [Average Grade Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/average-grade-calculator): Calculate simple, weighted, and points-based grade averages with support for dropped scores and category weights.
- [Semester Grade Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/semester-grade-calculator): Combine weighted coursework into an overall semester grade.
- [Final Grade Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/final-grade-calculator): Find the score needed on a final exam to reach a target grade.
- [Grade Curve Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/grade-curve-calculator): Adjust test scores using highest-score, square root, linear, bell curve, target average, and rank-based curving methods with instant statistics.
- [Marks Percentage Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/marks-percentage-calculator): Convert obtained marks and total marks into a percentage.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/percentage-calculator): Solve common percentage calculations.
- [CGPA to Percentage](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/cgpa-to-percentage): Convert CGPA into an estimated percentage.
- [SGPA to CGPA](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/sgpa-to-cgpa): Convert semester grade points into cumulative grade points.
- [SGPA to Percentage](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/sgpa-to-percentage): Convert SGPA into an estimated percentage.
- [Percentage to CGPA](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/percentage-to-cgpa): Convert percentage marks into an estimated CGPA.
- [Loan Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/loan-calculator): Estimate monthly payment, total repayment, and interest.
- [Tip Calculator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/tip-calculator): Calculate tip amount, total bill, and split amount.
- [Password Generator](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/password-generator): Generate secure browser-side passwords.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/privacy-policy): Explains privacy practices, local processing, analytics, and advertising data handling.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/cookie-policy): Explains cookies, cookie categories, opt-out options, and user controls.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/terms-of-service): Usage terms, acceptable use, advertising terms, and limitations.
- [Disclaimer](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/disclaimer): Important limitations and informational-use disclaimers.

## Features

- [Reusable Calculator Framework](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/): Shared UI structure for calculator cards, result panels, chart panels, and manual calculate flows.
- [Responsive Design](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/): Mobile-friendly layouts with consistent spacing, navigation, and theme support.
- [Local Input Handling](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/privacy-policy): User-entered values are processed in the browser and are not stored by the site.
- [Dark Theme Support](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/): Light/dark theme toggle across public pages and calculators.

## API

- [Public Website](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/): This project exposes user-facing web pages and calculators, not a documented public API.
- [llms.txt](https://www.averagegradecalculator.com/llms.txt): LLM-facing site map and project summary.
